description: Rich, deep purplish black fruits can grow to enormous size. Tender & tasty at all stages. http://burpee.com/more/60324
sowing_method: Start indoors in a warm, well-lighted area 8-10 weeks before last frost. Sow seeds in a seed starting formula in individual containers. Sow 1cm deep, firm lightly and keep evenly moist. Seedlings emerge 10-21 days.
